decisions.reason: A black-finish range is a surface variant of existing drainage know-how and manufacturing, so the firm can absorb market feedback easily and keep it at low cost, though its trend dependence and mere mention on the website leave some risk.

A shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on the firm's core shower-channel competence and barrier-free bathroom strategy, and it has a page of its own, so it is well understood and strategically central.

Pump-assisted drainage adds electromechanical knowledge less related to the firm's metal-drainage base, which makes early results harder to interpret, but it serves renovation and barrier-free markets, so the firm will likely keep it while learning.

A tileable floor drain with grating is a close extension of decades of floor-drain expertise, supported by existing planning tools and installer training, so the firm can assimilate and improve it readily.
A stainless steel design grate fits the firm's own metal manufacturing and design-led positioning, so it builds closely on existing knowledge and it has a dedicated page.
